item.description: Jim Long and Rabbi Chaim Richman ponder the creation of man, and share thoughts on this expansive Torah portion.

item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani defends his October 7 anniversary statement and again accuses Israel of genocide, despite criticism from Israeli and Jewish officials.

item.description: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood terrorist Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed on December 3.

item.title: Ofer Winter confronted in Bnei Brak: Take off your kippah, you're burning the Torah
item.description: Ofer Winter receives a warm reception in Bnei Brak before being confronted by extremist haredi protesters from the Jerusalem Faction, who shout insults at him.

item.title: Three injured in ATV rollover near Al-Eizariya, two seriously
item.description:
Three people were injured when an all-terrain vehicle overturned near Al-Eizariya.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams evacuated a man in his 30s to Hadassah Mount Scopus Hospital in serious condition, along with another man in his 30s who was moderately injured. A 15-year-old boy was evacuated to Shaare Zedek Hospital in serious condition.

item.title: Report: US prepares major Iran strike plans
item.description: The New York Times reports that the Pentagon is preparing a three-day military campaign against Iran as three US aircraft carriers head to the Middle East, though Trump is reluctant to strike.

item.title: Watch: Showing real 10/7 footage to 10/7 deniers
item.description: On the third anniversary of October 7th, Zach and Montana Tucker put deniers in VR headsets to watch the footage from that day, then bring out two survivors who were there.

item.title: US issues Middle East travel warning amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: The US State Department warns Americans of possible attacks and travel disruptions in the Middle East as Houthi hostilities against Saudi Arabia escalate.

item.title: From 3:55 to 6:40 a.m.: Former military sec. reveals what happened before the Hamas attack
item.description: Former military secretary Avi Gil recounts the dramatic hours leading up to October 7, including the initial 3:55 a.m. alert, his 6:29 a.m. call to Netanyahu, and an alleged attempt to alter official records.

item.title: Heavy gunfire near Kedumim: Forces deployed to the area
item.description: Multiple gunshots were heard this evening from the nearby village of Qaddum, alarming Kedumim residents. Local security forces and IDF troops were mobilized.

item.title: A man in his 30s was killed in a vehicle explosion at the entrance to Or Akiva
item.description:
A man in his 30s was killed in a vehicle explosion on Highway 4, near the Pal-Yam Junction at the entrance to Or Akiva.
According to the police he was a known criminal figure.

item.title: Israeli tourist dies suddenly in Madrid
item.description: The man in his 80s suffered cardiac arrest during a trip to Spain. ZAKA 360 coordinated with Israeli and Spanish officials to bring his body home for burial in Ashkelon.

item.title: Former Netanyahu military secretary claims: 'Braverman ordered October 7 transcript changed'
item.description:
Maj. Gen. (res.) Avi Gil, who served as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s military secretary during the October 7 massacre, claimed in an interview with Channel 12 News that Tzachi Braverman instructed a stenographer to change the time of a phone call held on the morning of the attack from 6:40 a.m. to 6:29 a.m.
According to Gil, the stenographer refused to make the change, and he informed the Attorney General’s legal adviser. Gil described the act as “forgery" and added: “Changing a transcript means changing the truth."

item.title: Haifa Mayor Yona Yahav eulogized Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus
item.description:
In the incident in which Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus fell, three IDF soldiers were lightly injured.
The soldiers were evacuated to receive medical treatment at a hospital, and their families have been notified.

item.title: Cpt. Eliav Haim Tzapalamus was killed during operational activity
item.description: Capt. Eliav Haim Tzapalamus, 21, from Haifa, was killed during operational activity in southern Lebanon when the Humvee he was traveling in overturned. Three other soldiers were lightly wounded.

item.title: Netanyahu surprised with 'Happy Birthday' at election rally
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu received an unexpected birthday surprise Thursday evening when hundreds of local officials, activists and public representatives broke into song to celebrate his 77th birthday.

item.title: 'Are you from Israel?': Police officer who saved two girls relives October 7 horror
item.description: Three years after Hamas’ massacre, Staff Sgt. Maj. Rami Cohen returns to the Sderot police station, where he rescued two little girls hiding beside their murdered mother before being shot 14 times and left wounded for two hours.

item.title: Moshe Feiglin: 'The price for peace should be giving Gaza back to the Jewish people'
item.description: 'The price should be that Gaza, that was always part of the Jewish Land, Eretz Israel, should be given back to the Jews. This is justice', says Zehut party chairman Moshe Feiglin on i24NEWS's new show, offering to relocate Gazans to Somaliland

item.title: Pedestrian killed after being struck by vehicle near Bar-Lev Industrial Zone
item.description: Magen David Adom paramedics pronounced the death of a woman in her 40s who was struck by a vehicle on Route 85 in the Lower Galilee, near the Bar-Lev Industrial Zone.

item.title: Shas blames anti-draft riots on attorney general
item.description: Shas claims draft-evasion arrests are politically motivated to weaken the right-wing bloc.

item.title: Donald Trump: 'US will not attack Iran before midterm elections'
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced that he will not attack Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. He said talks with Tehran are making progress and that the blockade will continue.

item.title: Watch: Haredi soldiers celebrate induction into IDF
item.description: A Haredi battalion broke into song and dance after swearing into the IDF at the Western Wall - while protests against the draft were underway elsewhere in Jerusalem.
